ps5Findings.version: Windows app v0.13.0 per repository README
requirements: Author-published community project; not an official Sony/Rockstar tool.

Requires the Windows PS Neighborhood app, compatible PS5Debug-NG, Story Mode and explicit MCP compare-and-write permission. Run GTA V In-Game Menu.cmd on the computer; the resident menu then remains inside the game until GTA restarts.
The author fingerprints separate native PS5 executables and refuses other builds; these PPSA versions are not the PS4 CUSA 1.56/1.57 update numbers.
The console-direct web workflow is stated to be unreleased. No browser one-click or standalone raw-ELF integration is established by this review.
ps5Findings.reasonNotAnAction: No existing site/F inventory entry matched this project, so no downloadable file, checksum or native Run action was fabricated.

ps5Findings.finding: etaHEN documents its own plugin system; the PS5 port repository contains explicitly ported general plugins. Neither reviewed source verifies these exact Velora/Beach/LTS/Serendipity/Expulsion/Cyprus PS4 binaries on PS5. Retain PS4-only recommendations until per-menu evidence exists.

The existing catalogue has ready FPS patch XML for a PS4 Orbis title, explicitly including backward compatibility on PS5. This is patch data for a separate native patch engine, not a full mod menu and not a native PS5 PPSA build.
